warnings.title: The D-toggle changes play_w without re-clamping the zoomed camera targets — in a height-bound-fit world, an east-panned zoomed camera leaves the world's east strip rendered under the opaque plate until the next camera input
warnings.evidence: effect_overlay: `app.overlay_on = !app.overlay_on` / `rnd.view_set_rail(...)` — no camera re-clamp; camera_update: `v.scale = fit * app.cam_zoom` / `v.off_x = f32(v.play_w)/2 - app.cam_wx * v.scale` — cam_wx/cam_wx_to never clamped here; the clamps live only in the input effects.
warnings.detail: At the default 1280x720 + 16:9 world the east bound is scale-invariant and lands exactly at play_w (recomputed by Perkins); but when camera_fit is HEIGHT-bound (taller-than-16:9 world/estate), the east margin survives the toggle: right edge = play_w/2 + win_w/2 = 1018 > 756 at 1280 — a persistent hidden strip until the player pans/zooms, contradicting the documented fit-to-rail invariant.
warnings.recommended_fix: Re-clamp cam_wx/cam_wy targets through camera_clamp_center on the rail flip in effect_overlay (same math as the input effects), or clamp cam targets in camera_update itself.
warnings.verification: confirmed (clamp placement read; scale-invariance + height-bound arithmetic recomputed)
